book_meta.work: The Seven Voyages of Sindbad, from ألف ليلة وليلة
book_meta.author: traditional

sentences.ar: بخامس ليلة، قال السندباد: هالمرة، اشتريت سفينة لحالي.
sentences.en: On the fifth night, Sindbad said: this time, I bought a ship of my own.
I said: the captain flees, and the captain forgets.
I will be the captain.
And I took merchants with me, and we sailed.

sentences.ar: وبيوم، وصلنا على جزيرة، وشفت عليها من بعيد قبة بيضا.
sentences.en: And one day, we reached an island, and I saw on it from afar a white dome.
And my heart stopped.
I said to the merchants: do not go down.
This is a giant bird's egg.
But the merchants did not listen.
They went down, and went around the egg.
And they struck it with stones, until they broke it.

sentences.ar: وطلع منها فرخ كبير زي البيت، وقتلوه، وأخدوا لحمه.
sentences.en: And a chick came out, big as a house, and they killed it, and took its meat.

sentences.ar: ورجعوا عالسفينة، وهم بيضحكوا، ومعهم اللحمة.
sentences.en: And they came back to the ship, laughing, with the meat.
I said: madmen!
Raise the sail!
Quickly!

sentences.ar: وقبل ما نبعد، صارت الدنيا عتمة.
sentences.en: And before we got away, the world went dark.
The birds, the mother and the father.
Two of them, their wings covering the sky.

sentences.ar: وشافوا البيضة المكسورة، وصرخوا صرخة كسرت قلوبنا.
sentences.en: And they saw the broken egg, and gave a scream that broke our hearts.
And they flew far off, and we thought they had gone.
But they came back.

sentences.ar: وبمخالب كل واحد، صخرة زي الجبل.
sentences.en: And in the claws of each, a rock like a mountain.

sentences.ar: الأول رمى صخرته، ووقعت جنب السفينة، والموج رفعنا للسما.
sentences.en: The first dropped its rock, and it fell beside the ship, and the wave lifted us to the sky.
And the second dropped its rock straight onto us.

sentences.ar: انكسرت السفينة نصين، وطارت الألواح، ووقعنا كلنا بالبحر.
sentences.en: The ship broke in two, planks flew, and we all fell into the sea.

sentences.ar: ومسكت لوح، مرة تانية، زي كل مرة.
sentences.en: And I grabbed a plank, once again, as every time.
And the porter said: every time a plank?
Sindbad said: every time.
God sends the plank, and the rest is up to me.
